paper_id: Dynamics of Open-Source Software Developer's Commit Behavior_ An Empirical Investigation of Subversion
title: Dynamics of Open-Source Software Developer's Commit Behavior: An Empirical Investigation of Subversion
motivation: 先前研究关注提交大小分布,但未深入研究提交间隔的动态规律
problem_framing: 用四个指标(PLCCI/PLICI/FLCCI/FLICI)形式化开发者的提交行为
key_insight: 开发者提交间隔遵循幂律分布,反映OSS协作开发的普遍规律
method_signature: 基于CDF估计幂律指数,对55个发布周期进行多函数拟合对比
evaluation_criteria: R²拟合优度>0.96为最佳,皮尔逊相关系数显著性检验
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Git等分布式系统结论是否适用尚不确定
evidence_for_taste: power-law distributions of lifecycle- and release-level
few of previous papers conducted empirical research
active committers' individual commit behavior are very similar
thinking_moves: 将Barabási的人类行为动力学框架移植到软件工程领域
从项目级/文件级、集体/个体四个维度构建指标体系
用CDF降噪来估计幂律标度指数
对多个发布阶段重复验证以检验规律是否重演
